visionMission.sectionTitle: Commitment to Smart Agricultural Research & Innovation
visionMission.sectionDesc: Smart Grow Laboratory at Telkom University is dedicated to becoming a center of excellence in applied technology, bridging engineering automation with modern plant physiology.
visionMission.visionText: "To become a leading research and innovation center at the national and international level in developing Smart Agriculture technologies, IoT automation, and AI biosystems to achieve robust, efficient, and sustainable food security."

missions.m01Desc: Conducting cutting-edge applied research in wireless telemetry sensors, edge AI, computer vision, and precision biosystem automation.
missions.m02Desc: Connecting laboratory innovation prototypes with real agricultural industry needs, grant programs (Kedaireka/Dikti), and farming communities.
missions.m03Desc: Organizing structured research internship ecosystems for students to cultivate future innovators and technology engineers.
missions.m04Desc: Implementing eco-friendly technologies, agrivoltaic renewable energy, and closed-loop water nutrient conservation.

research.sectionDesc: Smart Grow Laboratory serves as a research and incubation hub for smart agricultural engineering technologies spanning multiple applied science and systems engineering disciplines.

about.aboutLabDesc1: SMART GROW LAB is an integrated research and innovation hub focused on developing intelligent, sustainable, and data-driven agricultural systems. By leveraging cutting-edge technologies such as the Internet of Things (IoT), Artificial Intelligence (AI), and automation, SMART GROW LAB aims to revolutionize traditional farming practices and address global challenges related to food security, climate change, and resource efficiency.
about.aboutLabDesc2: Our core activities include the design and implementation of smart farming solutions—ranging from hydroponics and aquaponics to smart greenhouses and AIoT-based aquaculture monitoring systems. Through multidisciplinary collaboration and a commitment to sustainable development, SMART GROW LAB supports the transformation of agriculture into a high-tech, environmentally responsible sector.
